title: The Epistle to the Earl of Bedford
author: Alexis of Piemont
full_title: The Secretes of the Reuerende Maister Alexis of Piemount
summary: William Ward's title page and his dedication to Francis Russell, Earl of Bedford. God put secret virtues in herbs and other created things as signs of his favour; against Christians who scorn medicine because a man appointed to die cannot be saved, Ward defends physic as the most necessary learning, and presents the book, printed in French by Christopher Plantin of Antwerp, under Bedford's protection.
